case_number: 2024 INSC 247; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO(S). OF 2024 (Arising out of SLP(Crl.) No(s). 1936 of 2023)

parties.respondent: State Represented By The Inspector Of Police

summary: Juvenile jurisdiction violation; CICL tried without preliminary assessment; improper investigation by regular police instead of SJPU; inadmissible confession evidence; lack of Children's Court designation; conviction under IPC 363, 342, 302, 201 r/w 302, POCSO 6; trial vitiated for non-compliance with JJ Act 2015 procedural mandates; standard: mandatory compliance required; disposition: conviction set aside for improper procedure.
legal_provisions_cited: Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015 s.2(13)
Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015 s.3(1)
Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015 s.10
Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015 s.15
Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015 s.18(3)
Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015 s.19(1)(i)
Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015 s.101(2)
Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act, 2015 s.107(2)
final_judgment: Conviction set aside for procedural irregularities; case remanded to Juvenile Justice Board for preliminary assessment; trial to follow mandatory juvenile procedure under JJ Act 2015.
